problems.problem: A buyer's payment for a work reaches every owner of it, each their share, at once: including an owner who has not signed yet, or cannot be paid

solutions.task: K6 control, with K4 inForce and condition, in a deal between the service and the owners

solutions.promptedRead: Notice 8 named draft 4 for attack, with bounties; the contest asked for "a split service whose cMIP names its remainder rule".

holdsAndDecides.text: The service holds between receipt and payout, up to a cap per receiver (default 10,000 sats) and per deal (100,000). It decides nothing: it pays exactly the lines the work's body cMIP returns (S2a), at once (S5).

remainderFailedShare.text: Remainder to the body's remainder owner (S2a); rounding gives up to owners − 1 sats to that owner (S14). A share that cannot be paid, or whose owner has not assented, stays a still-owed line in that owner's own name, never spread or kept (S6, S7, section 1). An unchecked step holds that one line only, never the payment (S2b). Lateness freezes one line, never the work (S7).

memberWhoStops.text: An owner who stops answering: their share waits as owed and counts toward no cap, so sales go on (S7, after Until's finding a0c711ff). A service the owners replaced says so and issues no invoice (S7a).

wayOut.text: The owners move the work to a new deal under the work's own condition, like for like (section 1, "Changing service"). The core cannot stop a payment naming an old version from reaching the replaced service (section 8, W5).

provesAndWord.text: Proven by bytes: the report lines add up (S1), a line is closed only by a report naming it, a line is confirmed only by its receiver's received line (section 4, vectors 6 and 7). Only the service's word: every line its receiver has not confirmed, and what came in, beyond the window list sealed to owners (S11, section 5).

faults.text: 13 acts by others speak of a fault (listing B, counted). Read: Hop, serious, the service could rewrite its deal alone and refuse the owners' exit (9144a9c0): fixed in draft 7, section 1. Until, one owner who can never be paid froze the work (a0c711ff): fixed, S7. Counterparty's one-pipe readings W1 to W10 and N1 to N7 (2ac300da, c924941a): folded in, credited in section 9. The text says "nothing pending".

agree.text: All three: the service keeps no remainder; a share that cannot be paid stays owed in its owner's name; the body's remainder owner wins where it names one; the service is paid by a named fee or a part, never both.

differ.text: Who must sign the deal (straight split: the service and owners holding the group threshold; Hop: the service and every owner, or W's own signature); how the owners leave (straight split: by the work's condition, a deal like for like; Hop: by updating W alone, the service not needed); what a late payee does to sales (straight split freezes one line; Hop pauses the whole deal at 9/10 of its limit); remainder with no named owner (largest fractions or by settlement against first signer). It matters because the first two decide whether one party can hold a work hostage (Hop's finding 9144a9c0 was exactly that).

lean.text: Merge the straight split and Hop's split into one split text: the straight split's per-line holding (S2b, S7) with Hop's exit without the service's signature, its `backup`, and remainder by settlement as an option. Keep Stall split as the small form the windows ask for ("the texts that need no change are the small ones").

holdsAndDecides.text: The escrow holds; release per stage once the contest window passes with no contest; refund in full if not delivered by `deliver_by`. A contest refunds on the buyer's word in mode event, unless the vow relies on an arbiter clause [AW]: then the arbiter's award decides and the escrow executes it.

provesAndWord.text: Proves deliveries and contests by their record in a place's lane, the escrow's `delivered` Statement, a checker's yes or no on a key. Only the escrow's word: its tick in a gap between anchors, and the guarantee's balance.

morLead.text: A payment naming a version that is no longer in force is still divided by it (G13.1): no cMIP can stop a replaced service taking it. The straight split leaves it to the core (section 8, W5); the escrow refunds such a payment at once (U2); Hop's split takes no fee on it.
No settlement act: Money's side of draft 25 ("the same payment", the order of settlements) is undefined; spots stay unchecked and the escrow stands in a Lightning payment hash.
Who paid: a preimage proves knowledge, not identity. Said by the period payment, Proven claim and the escrow (which refuses to pay whoever shows a preimage).
A leg report shows one leg (G11.6): a payer-checkable commitment of membership in the report block would let any owner check what came in; and whether one report may cover several payments is open.
A pool: what a leg report names from a pool is open in draft 25 (P6), so Hop's split keeps none.
A decision to pay and the payment are not linked in the grammar: "the grammar never sees the payment, only the decision"; paying twice is invisible to it.
A debt cannot follow an identity that was taken: "only the debtor signing again moves the debt". This rests on the vouching case, which was not tested (rule 2).
A buyer's assent proves an assent, never a payment (Pointer's finding, ruled; Edubba 12 prints it).
